# sgit newsroom

> A newsroom whose beat is the sgit network: an index of what exists, daily editions of what changed, a historian's perspective, cross-pollination signals and loose ends. Built from a frozen, hashed snapshot; works offline.

Version v0.1.13. Snapshot 2026-09-24. Every page has a .md twin beside it.
